name: Global-Local Contrastive Learning
definition: A strategy to control stylization strength by using contrastive learning in CLIP space, combining global and local terms to ensure uniform stylization across the scene.
summary: Global-Local Contrastive Learning is a regularization strategy for text-driven NeRF stylization that ensures uniform style by combining global and local CLIP contrastive terms, overcoming directional-only and non-uniform limitations.
